_doc: Layout for tools/redraw_images.py (docs/image_redraw.md). styles: named presets. rules: glob -> spec, first match wins. files: per-texture specs (checked before rules). Spec keys: style, style_by_row, erase, erase_opt, box, items, skip. Item keys: row, line, text, fallbacks, box, erase (mode or {mode,...}), erase_box (one box or a list), share, blank, no_text, plus any style key. Boxes are [x, y, w, h] in texture pixels.
